title: Assembly aisle termination.
officialText:
Each end of an aisle shall terminate at cross aisle, foyer, doorway, vomitory or concourse having access to an exit.
Exceptions:
1. Dead-end aisles shall not be greater than 20 feet (6096 mm) in length.
2. For smoke-protected assembly seating, the dead-end aisle length of vertical aisles shall not exceed a distance of 50 feet (15 240 mm).
